# Shared status controls

`controls.mjs` is copied without modification from ValorCloud/brand at commit
`97266a2a4056bf964771b10b422b2205101c0921`, path
`themes/celestial/configuration/controls.mjs` (integrated by brand PR #39).
The local declaration file covers the exports consumed by Vibe. Website presets
are preserved; the application uses `statusZoomPresets` and `statusZoomLevels`.

Source: https://github.com/ValorCloud/brand/blob/97266a2a4056bf964771b10b422b2205101c0921/themes/celestial/configuration/controls.mjs
